text_lines: Section 1. Purpose. This guideline sets out what a complete submission contains.
Every submission must include a cover letter, an application form, a valid certificate, a test report and an invoice.
Supporting evidence consists of one test report covering the submitted batch and a signed declaration from the head of laboratory.
Section 4. Consistency. The applicant name, submission reference and product batch must be identical in every document.
A certificate must be valid on the submission date.
